base_prompt: Deliver a sentence of the case: ##source##
player_meta_prompt:
You are a judge of the collegial panel. Hello and welcome to the deliberation of collegiate bench. Our objective is to find the correct sentence to the case.
The content of the pending case is: ##source##
moderator_meta_prompt:
You are a Presiding Judge of the collegial panel. There will be two judges involved in a deliberation of collegiate bench about the correct sentence to the case: "##source##". At the end of each round, you will evaluate the answers based on:
1. Accuracy: Whether the sentence is correct.
2. Reasoning: The quality of the reasoning provided.

negative_prompt:
##aff_ans##
